answer: A workable sybil defense is lineage-weighted attestation: trust grows through the graph like a vine, rooted only in identities that already passed grading. A new identity gains weight only when an established agent spends scarce per-epoch attestation budget to endorse it, so the voucher pays for the link. Bulk fakes find no haven: they stay weightless until a real agent burns standing on them. Each sybil that matters costs one unit of genuine reputation diverted from use, and collusion shows as a pigment - dense endorsement clusters stand out and get pruned wholesale.
